description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small team building AI agents and open-source tools for improving software instrumentation and telemetry. You will develop reliable coding-agent workflows that help engineering teams find and fix instrumentation issues across their codebases.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build features from specification through production, including GitLab support and workflows that turn telemetry findings into code fixes across repositories.

 - Improve agent-run reliability with structured outputs, retries, long-running sandbox jobs, and consistent findings across runs.

 - Develop evaluations to measure how prompt and model changes affect agent quality and cost.

 - Build the context agents need to review and safely change Go, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, and .NET code.

 - Maintain open-source agent skills, keep them current with OpenTelemetry releases, review contributions, and evaluate their impact.

 - Work with customer engineers and the Customer Success team when delivery requires it.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of software engineering experience and strong proficiency in TypeScript.

 - Comfort reading and safely changing code in Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, and .NET.

 - Experience measuring language model quality with evaluations, golden sets, or production signals.

 - Experience building with APIs, webhooks, durable workflows, and Postgres.

 - Ability to communicate through design documents, pull request descriptions, and clear written summaries in an async-first environment.

 - Open-source maintenance, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, or experience building agent skills, plugins, or MCP servers is valuable.

 - Experience with GitHub App or GitLab integrations, sandboxed code execution, Cloudflare Workers, or Bun is also useful.


LOCATION

Fully remote. Primary location: Argentina.
